name: Chernivtsi

requestOutcomes.outcome: Official Chernivtsi municipal geoportal loaded after a 302 redirect to /home; page identifies the city geoportal and links to the municipal land-cadastre section.
Official help page states the geoportal provides spatial-data search and that land-parcel information is sourced from Ukraine's Public Cadastral Map.
Official Міський земельний кадастр page loaded and listed municipal land-auction and land-lease sections.
Current map HTML exposed the map component, public map id main, basemap configuration, and current JavaScript route /api-user/gis-format for anonymous point information.

Returned 82 public GIS layer definitions. The relevant catalog entries were lease contracts (cadastr_portal.orenda_docs, vtile, count 4715), sold auction parcels (data_parcel.land_auction_sold, geojson, count 0), and planned auction parcels (data_parcel.land_auction_prepare, geojson, count 0). No general cadastral parcel layer was identified.
Rejected with 'layer or table param is required'; recorded as route validation, not a service miss.
Lease-layer point lookup returned 'object not found'; no polygon or safe native parcel identity was retained.
Table-form point lookup also returned 'object not found'; this is not evidence of citywide absence.
Official regional StateGeoCadastre site found during native-language discovery; it documents cadastral and registration context but was not used for an anonymous polygon extraction.

Packet completion records research only; it is not source integration or runtime admission.
